context.transcript:
Oliver, thank you for volunteering to organize our
quarterly managers' meeting. I appreciate you taking
time out of your regular work schedule to do this.
Speaking of which, any updates on the lunch plans?
Well, I just heard from the restaurant we went to last
quarter. Unfortunately, they're fully booked that day.
Too bad. I was hoping they'd be available. Well, an
Italian restaurant just opened nearby.
I'll look into it. Also, I just received an e-mail from
the print shop. They're waiting for the presentation
schedule to add to the program. I'll send them an
updated version shortly.
context.transcript_translation:
奥利弗，谢谢你自愿负责组织我们的季度经理会议。很感谢你从日常工作安排中抽出时间来做这件事。说到这里，午餐安排有什么新进展吗？
嗯，我刚收到我们上季度去过的那家餐厅的消息。很遗憾，他们那天已经订满了。
真可惜，我本来希望他们有空位。不过附近刚开了一家意大利餐厅。
我去了解一下。另外，我刚收到印刷店的一封电子邮件。他们还在等演讲日程，以便把它加进会议手册。我很快会给他们发一份更新后的版本。
